drivers.label: Electricity vs peer
drivers.message: 2.00× the Illustrative fixed references electricity reference. Elevated use can indicate unusual load or inefficiency.
drivers.action: Review interval demand and electrical capacity with the facility engineer; check for changed occupancy or process load.

drivers.label: Water vs peer
drivers.message: 1.50× the Illustrative fixed references water reference. High use warrants investigation, not a leak diagnosis.
drivers.action: Compare after-hours water flow and meter boundaries; inspect fixtures and irrigation for unexplained demand.

drivers.label: Thermal load vs peer
drivers.message: 1.50× the Illustrative fixed references non-electric thermal reference; process and cooking loads may be included.
drivers.action: Review heating/cooling schedules and thermal meters; separate process loads before assessing HVAC performance.

drivers.label: Electricity trend
drivers.message: 30.0% year-over-year electricity intensity change.
drivers.action: Reconcile meter coverage, occupied hours and recent equipment changes before inspecting loads.

drivers.label: Electrical cascade
drivers.message: Electricity priority above 50 adds 12.5 HVAC points through the one-way dependency.
drivers.action: Review power continuity for HVAC controls and critical cooling; verify backup circuits and restart procedures.

drivers.label: Building vintage
drivers.message: Building age is 60 years; equipment replacement history is unknown.
drivers.action: Obtain equipment age, envelope condition and maintenance history to replace this weak vintage proxy.

drivers.label: Water trend
drivers.message: 10.0% year-over-year water intensity change.
drivers.action: Reconcile annual meter totals and occupancy; investigate persistent unexplained water increases.

drivers.label: Heat exposure
drivers.message: 30 days with a regional daily maximum of at least 32°C.
drivers.action: Check cooling capacity, filters and heat-wave readiness before the hot season.

drivers.label: Cold exposure
drivers.message: 60 days with a regional daily minimum below 0°C.
drivers.action: Review heating reliability and cold-weather controls with the facilities team.

warnings: Priority index based on screening proxies; not a calibrated failure probability or a safety certification.
